pos.personaBrief: Spielverlagerung says the team controls play 'without keeping it for a long time', and Koke says 'We used the counter-attack... We dominated without the ball'. Low possession and 20 clean sheets: control without the ball.

pro.personaBrief: Transitions are 'almost perfect' and Costa and Villa drop as wall players for fast layoffs, so the team goes forward quickly. It is also 'excellent at altering their passing rhythm', and Gabi and Tiago win loose balls and keep it simple.

est.personaBrief: A compact, rehearsed 4-4-2 ('compact, well organized'), with a midfield chain narrower than the back line. The wingers sit inside and Koke drifts into the left half-space; the forwards drop as wall players.

lar.personaBrief: The wingers sit in midfield rather than on the touchlines, and width comes mainly from the full-backs (Filipe Luis among the best left-backs). Godín's headers and near-post corners show the danger came from the box and wide deliveries, not from wingers going one-on-one.

blo.personaBrief: A 4-4-2 with a deep midfield press, not a high press, though Costa pressed from the front ('sometimes high and sometimes low'). The team had the best defence in La Liga (26 conceded) with compact lines.

mar.personaBrief: The block is compact and protects space, with man-oriented duties only out wide ('full-backs man-mark their opposing wingers'). No source describes a dedicated man-marker on a star.

pla.personaBrief: Simeone imposes a clear collective identity (compact 4-4-2, transitions, set pieces) and approaches each game 'partido a partido'. Against Real Madrid and Barcelona the team simply ran its own reactive model, and Simeone values 'serenity' when things are going well.

res.personaBrief: 'We fought and competed with humility, against everything': the profile is all about results. It sealed the title with a draw at the Camp Nou and 'defended with all players' in the final.

sis.personaBrief: A short squad that won the league over the giants through collective work ('no substitute for hard work', 'an incredible amount of work'). Everyone, Costa included, presses and defends.

jog.personaBrief: 'A lot of athleticism and aggressiveness', 'absolutely relentless', with Gabi and Tiago winning loose balls. Set pieces and Godín's headers decided key games, although the technically good Tiago and Villa also started.

bas.personaBrief: The core was mostly experienced (Villa 32, Tiago 33, Gabi 31, Godín 28), plus signings. Youngsters Giménez (19) and Manquillo (20) were fringe players, although Koke (21) and Courtois (22) were key.

lid.personaBrief: Simeone praises 'un grupo humano' that 'never stopped fighting', a united group built on effort under a demanding coach whose collective rules bind everyone. The evidence on management is weak and comes only from end-of-season quotes.
